Frequently asked questions

Common questions about appeal an ssi denial

Why was my SSI claim denied?

Common reasons include income or resources exceeding SSI limits, insufficient medical evidence of disability, failure to cooperate with the SSA, or the SSA determined you are not disabled under their definition.

Can I appeal an SSI denial?

Yes. The appeal process is the same as SSDI: reconsideration, ALJ hearing, Appeals Council, and federal court. You have 60 days from receiving the denial to request reconsideration.

What is the difference between SSI and SSDI appeals?

The appeal process is identical. The difference is the eligibility criteria — SSI is need-based (income and resources), while SSDI is based on work credits. Your appeal should address the specific denial reason.
